Subject: Segmented burst planning kickoff — QBR + next steps

Hi Sofia — thanks for taking the time today. Quick kickoff note to align on timeline, stakeholders, and immediate next steps for the upcoming renewal and planned capacity uplift. Objectives for this thread:

- Confirm revised term & staged capacity increases for Q4 (per your renewal window).
- Align engineering and ops owners for a segmented burst plan (high/med/low tiers).
- Schedule a brief QBR to review traffic profile, SLAs, and the mutual action plan (MAP).

Proposed immediate timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and agree on QBR slot.
2) Week 1–2: enable prefix/KV caching adjustments and deploy one-step GPU bump for the pilot segment.
3) Week 3–6: roll out staged capacity increases + runbook handoff and monitoring hooks.

Can you (a) confirm which stakeholders from BrightBridge should be on the QBR (ops, infra, procurement), and (b) share a representative 24‑hour traffic profile CSV so we can model queuing and burst cost? I’ve attached an initial runbook and a capacity proposal to help with discussion.

Suggested QBR windows (PDT):
- Wed Oct 7: 8:30–9:15 / 11:00–11:45
- Thu Oct 8: 9:30–10:15 / 13:30–14:15

If none of those work, please propose two times and we’ll lock. Next steps from our side after your reply: assign eng on-call, validate billing cadence for staged commit, and circulate a short MAP doc for signatures.

Attachments: initial-runbook-draft.pdf (runbook summary), staggered-capacity-proposal.xlsx (capacity by segment)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Engineering commitments: enable KV prefix caching and apply optimizer flags (low-latency path) in Week 1; if telemetry looks good, add +2 dedicated vGPU units to the pilot pool Week 2.
- Billing: staged commits will be reflected as a month-over-month reserved capacity uplift. Procurement trigger = signed MAP (DocuSign link below). We’ll include clear change-of-state notifications in billing so Alan has granular visibility.

I’ve attached a draft MAP (MAP-BrightBridge-v1.docx) and added a short SLA summary in the appendix. HubSpot deal is updated with the timeline.
